title: Odell Beckham Jr. reclaims iconic No. 13 jersey, discusses chance to 'rewrite history' with Giants

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Odell Beckham Jr. reclaims iconic No. 13 jersey, discusses chance to 'rewrite history' with Giants
sources.description: The 33-year-old receiver secures his roster spot after missing the entire 2025 season, reuniting with head coach John Harbaugh ahead of the Giants' Week 1 matchup against the Cowboys
